artifacts.summary: The paper's app:gluing proved in full generality at the convex-history layer, wired in, choice-freeness pinned by C14, and the ten citation sites repointed.

completion_data.completion_summary: FormalSystem/Semantics/Gluing.lean proves app:gluing in full generality for two convex histories with a nonempty overlap: convexGlue with its reading and bridge lemmas, convexity of the union, both Extends identities, uniqueness, and the two entry points gluing_clause and gluing_clause_of_overlap, plus the ray-seam instance witness. The module is wired into FormalSystem.Semantics and the regenerated library root; the choice-free claim rmk:choice makes for the lemma is asserted on every build by two matched C14 heredoc rows pinning [propext, Quot.sound] rather than left as prose; and the ten app:gluing citation sites that named only a special case now name the general declaration, with the three landed special cases left independent by recorded decision.
